system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Agents communicate with the underlying LLMs through prompt templates defined in Jinja2 format.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-agent prompt.jinja2 files rendered with current context.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: ReadCode`: Recursively reads code files in a directory and converts them into a Markdown format
env_context_strategy.note: Project files read into prompts plus web research/browsing; no repo navigation tools for the model.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Devika can capture screenshots of the web pages visited, which can be useful for visual reference or debugging purposes.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Validate and parse the LLM's response to extract structured output
tool_call_format.note: Responses parsed from text; browser crawler uses commands like "CLICK 12".

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Segments code into appropriate files and directories
edit_primitive.note: Coder emits full file contents saved to the project directory.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: A prompt template that provides examples of how to use these actions

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Integrations are done in a modular way so that new services can be added easily.
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A in file tree or docs.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The prompt is first passed to the Planner agent to generate a step-by-step plan.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Generates a high-level step-by-step plan based on the user's prompt
planning_granularity.note: Plan stored and fed to later agents.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Devika's cognitive abilities are powered by a collection of specialized sub-agents.
multi_agent_topology.note: Agent Core sequences specialised agents; could also be read as orchestrator_workers.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The corresponding specialized agent is invoked to perform the action (Runner, Feature, Patcher, Reporter).

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Prompts the user for additional context if required
human_in_loop.note: Chat interface lets user steer; no per-action approval described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The `AgentState` class handles this by providing an interface to

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Project metadata is persisted in a SQLite database using SQLModel.
long_term_memory.note: Conversation history and agent states persisted across sessions; src/memory/knowledge_base.py and rag.py also shipped.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Storing project and agent state in a DB to enable pause/resume and auditing

self_verification.evidence_quote: Performs incremental testing to verify feature is working as expected
self_verification.note: Coder validates syntax/style and reviews its own code; Runner executes code and rerunner.jinja2 handles errors.

retry_policy.note: rerunner.jinja2 suggests retry after failed run; no fixed cap documented.

rollback.evidence_quote: The generated code is saved to the project directory on disk.
rollback.note: No undo/revert mechanism described; git service only clone/pull.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Mark the agent as active/inactive or task as completed

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Tracking and accumulating token usage over time
cost_controls.note: Token usage tracked but no budget cap, routing or caching described.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Executes the written code in a sandboxed environment
execution_isolation.note: Runs on host OS (Mac/Linux/Windows); src/sandbox/firejail.py present; docker files shipped for the app itself.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Creating a new project and initializing its directory structure
filesystem_access.note: Work is scoped to the project directory; boundary is the host.

network_policy.evidence_quote: The Agent performs web searches using Bing Search API and crawls the top results.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Executes the corresponding function with provided arguments

tracing.evidence_quote: Having a persistent log of agent states is useful for
tracing.note: JSON-serialized state list per project in SQLite; Logger also ships.

replayability.note: States are logged but no replay path described.

eval_hooks.note: Benchmarks docs only; no runner code visible in the tree.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Executes the corresponding function with provided arguments
guardrails.note: No filters or action blocklists documented; firejail sandbox file exists but unreferenced in docs.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Devika is an advanced AI software engineer that can understand high-level human instructions, break them down into steps, research relevant information, and write code to achieve the given objective.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The `LLM` class abstracts out the specifics of each provider's API, allowing agents to interact with the models in a consistent way.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Devika is the first open-source implementation of an Agentic Software Engineer.
